title: The title decider
subtitle: Abu Dhabi 2021
context: The final chapter of Verstappen v Hamilton

events.label: The launch
events.title: Hamilton takes the lead off the line
events.description: Hamilton gets the better launch and passes Verstappen on the pit straight, taking control of the race immediately.

events.label: First flashpoint
events.title: Verstappen attacks at Turns 6 and 7
events.description: Verstappen dives inside at Turn 6. Hamilton runs wide through the escape area and retains the lead, leaving the title rivals in the same order.

events.label: The first stops
events.title: Pérez brings Verstappen back into play
events.description: Verstappen pits on lap 13 and Hamilton responds a lap later. Pérez stays out in the lead and holds Hamilton up, allowing Verstappen to close an 11-second pre-stop deficit to just 1.3 seconds by lap 21.

events.label: Clear air
events.title: Hamilton rebuilds his advantage
events.description: With Pérez out of the way and both title contenders in clear air, Hamilton steadily stretches the gap again.

events.label: Virtual Safety Car
events.title: A cheap stop gives Verstappen fresher tyres
events.description: Giovinazzi retires and triggers a Virtual Safety Car. Verstappen pits for fresh hard tyres while Hamilton stays out. The gap falls from roughly 17 seconds to 11, but Verstappen is still not closing quickly enough to catch him on track.

events.label: Safety Car
events.title: Latifi crashes at Turn 14
events.description: Latifi crashes at Turn 14 and the Safety Car is deployed. Verstappen can pit for soft tyres; Hamilton, with Verstappen immediately behind him on the road, cannot make the same stop without surrendering track position.

events.label: One lap to go
events.title: The five cars between the leaders are released
events.description: The five lapped cars positioned between Hamilton and Verstappen are instructed to pass the Safety Car and unlap themselves, putting the two title rivals together for the restart.

events.label: Final lap
events.title: Verstappen passes Hamilton at Turn 5
events.description: On fresh soft tyres, Verstappen attacks Hamilton into Turn 5, takes the lead and holds it to the flag to win the race and the World Championship.
